title: Ziyarat of Imam Husayn on Eid
intro: The longer Eid visitation and its related supplication in the source edition, with salutations to Ali Akbar, the martyrs and Abbas.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Husayn on Eid with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
recited on the eve of Eid

Scholars have dedicated two forms of ziyarah for . Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha.

The first form is the Ziarat on Qadr Nights,which is for the "DAY" of Eid and the other given below is for the Eve of Eid based on what is apparently understood from the words of the scholars.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صَفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama safwati allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam the choice of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ امِينِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin amini allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah the trustee of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you O inheritor of Abraham the Friend of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses the spoken by Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus the spirit of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad,

blocks.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi habibi allahi
blocks.english: blessings of Allah be upon him and his Household, the most-beloved of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عَلِيٍّ حُجَّةِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of `Ali the Argument of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلْوَصِيُّ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلْتَّقِيُّ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O obedient and pious successor.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ وَٱلْوِتْرَ ٱلْمَوْتُورَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi walwitra almawtura
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance, and the unavenged so far.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the evil,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: and strove for the sake of Allah as exactly as strife must be

blocks.transliteration: hatta istubiha haramuka wa qutilta mazluman
blocks.english: until your inviolability was violated and you were slain wrongfully.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Aba-`Abdullah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the prophets’ successors.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah the luminous lady
and the doyenne of the women of the worlds.
Peace be upon you, O hero of Muslims.
O my master,

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوراً فِي ٱلاصْلاَبِ ٱلشَّامِخَةِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka kunta nuran fi al-aslabi alshshamikhati
blocks.english: I bear witness that You were light in the lofty loins
and purified wombs.
The ignorance could not stain you with its impurities

blocks.transliteration: wa lam tulbiska min mudlahimmati thiyabiha
blocks.english: or dress you its gloomy garbs.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka min da`a'imi alddini
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you are one of the pillars of the religion,
the supports of Muslims,
and the havens of the faithful believers.

blocks.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّكَ ٱلإِمَامُ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلتَّقِيُّ ٱلرَّضِيُّ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka al-imamu albarru alttqiyyu alrrdiyyu
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you are the God-fearing, pious, pleased,
pure, guide, and well-guided Imam.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna al-a'immata min wuldika
blocks.english: I also bear witness that the Imams from your progeny
are the spokesmen of piety, the signs of guidance,
the firmest handle (of Islam),
and the arguments against the inhabitants of this world.

blocks.transliteration: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
blocks.english: To Allah we belong and to Him is our return.
O my master, I am loyal to your loyalists
and enemy of your enemies.

blocks.transliteration: wa ana bikum mu'minun wa bi'iyabikum
blocks.english: I also believe in you all and in your Return
and I have full confidence in the laws of my religion
and in the seals of my deeds.
My heart is at peace with your heart
and all my affairs are following your commands.
O my master, I have come to you fearful; so, (please) secure me.
I have come to you seeking shelter; so, (please) grant me shelter.
I have come to you deprived; so, (please) grant me wealth.
My chief and master,

blocks.arabic: انْتَ مَوْلاَيَ حُجَّةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْخَلْقِ اجْمَعِينَ
blocks.transliteration: anta mawlaya hujjatu allahi `ala alkhalqi ajma`ina
blocks.english: you are, O my master, Allah’s argument against all of His creatures.
I believe in your secret and open affairs,
in your visible and invisible affairs,
and in the foremost and the last of you.

blocks.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّكَ ٱلتَّالِي لِكِتَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَامينُ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka alttali likitabi allahi wa aminu allahi
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you have recited the Book of Allah and you are the Trustee of Allah,

blocks.arabic: ٱلدَّاعِي إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ
blocks.transliteration: aldda`i ila allahi bilhikmati walmaw`izati alhasanati
blocks.english: who calls to Allah with wisdom and excellent exhortation.
May Allah curse the people who wronged you.

blocks.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ امَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَتْ بِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan sami`at bidhalika faradiyat bihi
blocks.english: May Allah curse the people who were pleased when they heard of that.

blocks.text: You may then turn to `Ali ibn al-Husayn (`a), who is buried to the side of Imam al-Husayn’s feet, and say the following words:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s intimate servant.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the seal of the prophets.
Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah
the doyenne of the women of the worlds.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon you, O persecuted and martyred.
May Allah accept my father and my mother as ransoms for you.
You lived happily
and were killed as wronged and martyred.

blocks.text: You may then turn to the tombs of the martyrs—may Allah’s pleasure be upon them—and say the following

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ ايُّهَا ٱلذَّابُّونَ عَنْ تَوْحِيدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you all, O defenders of (the faith of) Allah’s Oneness.
Peace be upon you because you were constant.
How excellent then the issue of the abode is.
May Allah accept my father and my mother as ransoms for you.
You achieved a great success.

blocks.text: You may then walk to the shrine of al-`Abbas ibn `Ali, stop at his holy tomb, and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلْعَبْدُ ٱلصَّالِحُ وَٱلصِّدِّيقُ ٱلْمُوَاسِي
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha al`abdu alssalihu walssiddiqu almuwasi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah) and veracious self-sacrificing.
I bear witness that you believed in Allah,
supported the son of Allah’s Messenger,
called to the way of Allah,
and sacrificed yourself for Him.

blocks.arabic: فَعَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ افْضَلُ ٱلتَّحِيَّةِ وَٱلسَّلاَمِ
blocks.transliteration: fa`alayka min allahi afdalu alttahiyyati walssalami
blocks.english: So, the most favorite greetings and compliments of Allah be upon you.

blocks.text: You may now throw yourself on the tomb and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي يَا نَاصِرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya nasira dini allahi
blocks.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O supporter of Allah’s religion.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَاصِرَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O supporter of al-Husayn the veracious.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَاصِرَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O supporter of al-Husayn the martyr.
Peace from me be upon you

blocks.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
blocks.english: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.

blocks.text:
You may then stand up to offer a two-unit prayer to the side of his head and then repeat the same words that you have said after offering a prayer at Imam al-Husayn’s shrine. These words, which have been previously cited, begin with the following statement:
allahumma inni laka sallaytu

wa laka raka`tu wa laka sajadtu…

If you intend to leave and bid farewell to the Imam (`a), you may stop at the side of the head and say the following words while weeping:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O my master.

blocks.arabic: سَلاَمَ مُوَدِّعٍ لاََ قَالٍ وَلاَ سَئِمٍ
blocks.transliteration: salama muwaddi`in la qalin wa la sa'imin
blocks.english: This is the greeting of one who has to bid you farewell although he is neither bored with you nor tired of you.
If I leave (you), this is not because of weariness,

blocks.arabic: وَإِنْ اقِمْ فَلاَ عَنْ سُوءِ ظَنٍّ
blocks.transliteration: wa in uqim fala `an su'i zannin
blocks.english: and if I reside, this is not because of mistrusting
the promise that Allah has made for the serene ones.

blocks.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ لاََ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: ya mawlaya la ja`alahu allahu akhira al`ahdi minni liziyaratika
blocks.english: O my master, may Allah not decide this time of my visit to you to be the last
and may He endue me with more chances to re-visit you,
to reside in your sanctuary,
and to be in your presence.
Respond to me, O Lord of the worlds!

blocks.text: You may then kiss the tomb and try to pass your entire body over it, because this tomb is security and protection. You may then leave it by walking backwards without giving your back to the tomb. You may say the following words:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O door to the High Position.
Peace be upon you, O partner of the Quran.
Peace be upon you, O argument against disputants.
Peace be upon you, O ark of salvation.
Peace be upon you all, O angels of my Lord
who are residing in this sanctuary.
Peace be upon you forever

blocks.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
blocks.english: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.

blocks.text: You may also say the following words:

blocks.transliteration: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
blocks.english: To Allah we belong and to Him is our return.

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
blocks.english: There is neither might nor power except with Allah the All-high and All-great.

blocks.text:
You may then leave.

Sayyid Ibn Tawus and Muhammad ibn al-Mashhadi said, “If you do all these devotional acts (correctly), you will be as if you have visited Almighty Allah in His Divine Throne.”
You may then offer a two-unit prayer and when you finish, you may say the following words:

blocks.english: O Allah, I have offered a prayer for You

blocks.transliteration: wa laka raka`tu wa laka sajadtu
blocks.english: and I have genuflected and prostrated myself for You
alone without setting any partner to You,
because prayers,
genuflections, and prostrations are illegal for anyone save You,

blocks.arabic: لاِنَّكَ انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاََ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
blocks.transliteration: li'annaka anta allahu alladhi la ilaha illa anta
blocks.english: because You are Allah; there is no god save You.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
convey to them the most favorite salutations and greetings from me,
and convey to me their response to my greeting.

blocks.transliteration: allahumma wa hatani alrrak`atani hadiyyatun minni
blocks.english: O Allah, these two units of prayer are a present from me
to my master al-Husayn the son of `Ali,
peace be upon both of them.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon him,
accept these two units of prayer from me, and reward me for them

blocks.arabic: افْضَلَ امَلِي وَرَجَائِي فِيكَ وَفِي وَلِيِّكَ
blocks.transliteration: afdala amali wa raja'i fika wa fi waliyyika
blocks.english: by granting me the best of my hope and expectation in you and in Your Friend,
O Guardian of the believers!
Peace be upon al-Husayn the son of `Ali,
the wronged and martyred,
the victim of shed tears,
and the captive of agonies.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اشْهَدُ انَّهُ وَلِيُّكَ وَٱبْنُ وَلِيِّكَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma inna ashhadu annahu waliyyuka wabnu waliyyika
blocks.english: O Allah, I do bear witness that he is Your intimate friend and the son of Your intimate friend
and Your choicest one who revolted to demand with Your right.
You have thus honored him with Your honor,
sealed his lifetime with martyrdom,
made him one of the chiefs
and one of the leaders,
honored him with immaculate birth,
gave him the inheritances of the prophets,

blocks.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَهُ حُجَّةً عَلَىٰ خَلْقِكَ مِنَ ٱلاوْصِيَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ja`altahu hujjatan `ala khalqika min al-awsiya'i
blocks.english: and made him argument against Your creatures and one of the Successors.
So, he called to You flawlessly,
gave advice,
and sacrificed himself for Your sake

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ ٱسْتَنْقَذَ عِبَادَكَ مِنَ ٱلْجَهَالَةِ وَحَيْرَةِ ٱلضَّلاَلَةِ
blocks.transliteration: hatta istanqadha `ibadaka min aljahalati wa hayrati alddalalati
blocks.english: until he could save Your servants from ignorance and perplexity of straying off.

blocks.arabic: وَقَدْ تَوَازَرَ عَلَيْهِ مَنْ غَرَّتْهُ ٱلدُّنْيَا
blocks.transliteration: wa qad tawazara `alayhi man gharrat-hu alddunya
blocks.english: Yet, those whom were seduced by this worldly life,

blocks.transliteration: wa ba`a hazzahu min al-akhirati bil-adna
blocks.english: those who sold their share of the Hereafter with the lowly price,
those who perished because of following their desires,
those who brought to themselves Your wrath and the wrath of Your Prophet,

blocks.arabic: وَاطَاعَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ اوْلِي ٱلشِّقَاقِ وَٱلنِّفَاقِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ata`a min `ibadika uli alshshiqaqi walnnifaqi
blocks.english: and those who obeyed the dissident and hypocritical servants of You
and the bearers of the burdens (of sins) who deserve Hellfire—all those supported each other against him;
so, he fought against them with steadfastness and expectation of Your reward,
facing them courageously, never turning back,

blocks.arabic: لاََ تَاخُذُهُ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
blocks.transliteration: la ta'khudhuhu fi allahi lawmatu la'imin
blocks.english: and never fearing the blame of anyone concerning carrying out his duty towards You
until his blood was shed while he was in obedience to You
and his inviolability was also infringed.
O Allah, curse them with incessant curses
and chastise them with painful chastisement.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام حسین روز عید کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
